name: Okteto

modes.label: Native product; see regime notes
modes.note: Okteto sells a per-seat platform licence (annual contract) that runs on the customer's own Kubernetes cluster (Self-Hosted Helm chart or Okteto-managed BYOC in the customer's AWS/GCP account). Okteto does not sell compute; CPU/RAM/disk/egress are billed by the customer's cloud. Rates stay null by design.

plans.name: Starter
plans.note: Free for up to 5 seats; Self-Hosted only (Free Tier license key by form); no BYOC, no SOC2, no SSO/RBAC, no garbage collector/resource manager. Customer supplies and pays for the Kubernetes cluster.

plans.name: Scale
plans.note: Per seat, billed annually; price not published. Adds catalog, resource manager, garbage collection, RBAC, SSO (GitHub/Google), SOC2, ticket support + SLA. Self-hosted only (no BYOC).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Per seat, annual; multi-cluster/floating licence counts unique seats across fleet; BYOC, OIDC, air-gapped, GitOps control. Also via Google Cloud Marketplace / AWS Marketplace.

free.conditions: Free Tier licence key emailed after self-hosted form (https://www.okteto.com/free-trial/); Free Tier licence only works with Self-Hosted. BYOC free access only via sales demo.

caveats: Starter free (5 seats, self-hosted only). Scale/Enterprise: per-seat, annual contract, contact sales; seats = unique human user accounts (agents/bots/environments not counted); overages trued-up pro-rata at contracted rate, no hard cap. Compute always runs on and is billed by the customer's own Kubernetes cluster (Self-Hosted or BYOC on AWS/GCP); no Okteto-hosted compute tariff exists.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

snapshot_auto.quote: Kubernetes Deployments (replicas set to 0, so that pods are deleted but the deployment config remains)
snapshot_auto.note: Garbage-collector 'sleep' (idle period, default 3h) scales workloads to zero and deletes pods; 'Persistent Volume Claims (PVCs) and their data' are preserved. That is persistent_disk, not a state snapshot; no memory/process state kept.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: Okteto Volume Snapshots allow you to initialize Persistent Volume Claims (PVCs) with data from a previously created snapshot.
snapshot_on_demand.note: PVC-level (disk only, no memory) via Kubernetes VolumeSnapshot objects; new environments/namespaces can restore PVCs from it via dev.okteto.com/from-snapshot-name annotation. Needs CSI snapshot driver on self-hosted; BYOC uses csi-okteto storage class.

harness_api.quote: The [Okteto plugin for Claude Code](https://github.com/okteto/okteto-agent-skills) packages that knowledge as agent skills
harness_api.note: Current 'Agentic Workflows' = skills/plugin for an agent running outside (IDE/CI) that calls the Okteto CLI. The former 'Okteto AI' (ex 'AI Agent Fleets', beta Sept 2025, Claude Code per namespace driven from a dashboard UI) appears discontinued: release 1.48.0 (Sep 2026) says 'The `oktetoAI` and `prepullImages.includeAgent` settings have been removed from the Okteto Chart'. No documented API for it even when it existed.

egress_allowlist.quote: `egress`: Egress list of rules (NetworkPolicyEgressRule) to be applied on every namespace managed by Okteto (optional).
egress_allowlist.note: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy (ipBlock CIDR + ports), admin-level Helm config applied to every Okteto namespace, 'Disabled by default'; enforced by the cluster CNI outside the container. Not per-sandbox and no hostname rules. Customer can additionally run their own policy tooling on their own cluster.

ingress_rules.quote: Private endpoints can only be accessed by Okteto users who have access to your Okteto namespace, and they'll need to provide their credentials before being granted access.
ingress_rules.note: Endpoints are public by default; annotation dev.okteto.com/auto-ingress: "private" makes them Okteto-auth protected. Admins can also set NetworkPolicy ingress rules (ipBlock/namespace/pod selectors) per namespace via Helm networkPolicies.ingress.

secret_proxy.quote: Okteto Variables are a way to parametrize your [Okteto manifest](/docs/reference/okteto-manifest.md) and the deploy, destroy and test strategy.
secret_proxy.note: Secrets are Okteto Variables (admin/user/catalog), env vars and Kubernetes secrets; no credential-injecting proxy documented. New x-okteto-identity-token projects an OIDC ServiceAccount token into the container (workload identity), which is not a proxy.

volume_attach.quote: A list of persistent volume claims (not managed by Okteto) that you want to mount in your development container.
volume_attach.note: Any Kubernetes PVC (externalVolumes) plus the Okteto dev volume (persistentVolume, default 5Gi, configurable size/storageClass/accessMode).

volume_shared.quote: This is useful to share cache information between different development containers.
volume_shared.note: Same external PVC mounted by several dev containers; simultaneous read-write needs a ReadWriteMany-capable storage class on the customer's cluster (default dev volume access mode is ReadWriteOnce).
